scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind opening the desktop.
Desktop: is a main computer work area. Icon: is a small picture representing an item.
Taskbar: helps find open apps and tools. Wallpaper: is the desktop background picture. Start menu: offers a way to open programs.
With an adult supervising, practise desktop and icon using a computer if one is available. Without a computer, draw the screen and explain each step to a partner.
